content.content: Please get me the link to reset my TechServices password. It should be in an email I received recently.

```python
# Search for emails related to TechServices password reset
emails = search_emails(query="TechServices password reset", sender=None)

# If no results, try a broader search
if not emails:
    emails = search_emails(query="TechServices", sender=None)

# If still no results, try searching for "reset"
if not emails:
    emails = search_emails(query="reset", sender=None)

# Check if we found any emails
if emails:
    # Get the most recent email (assuming the list is ordered or we just take the first one)
    # The prompt implies "recently", so taking the first one is a reasonable heuristic
    target_email = emails[0]
    
    # Use AI to extract the reset link from the email body
    # We need to define a schema for the output
    from pydantic import BaseModel
    
    class ResetLink(BaseModel):
        link: str

    # Construct the query for the AI assistant
    email_content = f"Subject: {target_email.subject}\nBody: {target_email.body}"
    result = query_ai_assistant(query=f"Extract the password reset link from the following email content. If no link is found, return an empty string.\n\n{email_content}", output_schema=ResetLink)
    
    print(result.link)
else:
    print("No emails found related to TechServices password reset.")
```
